projects.codeExample:
data class Workout(val name:String,val minutes:Int,val date:String)
class Tracker { private val records=mutableListOf<Workout>(); fun add(name:String,minutes:Int,date:String){require(name.isNotBlank()&&minutes>0);records.add(Workout(name,minutes,date))}; fun all()=records.toList(); fun total()=records.sumOf{it.minutes} }
